Default quality-score thresholds and weights

Source: R/quality-score.R
quality_thresholds_default.Rd

The literature-informed default scoring table used by score_sample_quality() when no QC-relative calibration is requested. One row per metric, giving the green (full-marks) and amber (half-marks) thresholds, the scoring direction, the composite weight, and a human-readable label. Edit or pass a modified copy to override. Metrics whose absolute thresholds are NA (the depth metrics) are scored only in QC-relative mode (see calibrate_thresholds_from_qc()).

Usage

quality_thresholds_default(mhcclass = "MHC1")

Arguments

mhcclass

MHC class the thresholds are for. "MHC1_mouse" relabels the frac_9mer row to "8/9-mer fraction" and raises its green/amber cut-offs, because that metric counts two canonical lengths for murine H-2. "MHC2" promotes frac_nested_core from a weight-0 diagnostic to the motif dimension (weight 3), since the anchor metric is undefined there.

Value

A data frame with columns metric, label, direction ("higher_better"/"lower_better"), green, amber, weight.

Examples

quality_thresholds_default()
#>                    metric                              label     direction
#> 1          frac_in_window                   Length in window higher_better
#> 2               frac_9mer                     9-mer fraction higher_better
#> 3  frac_cterm_KR_longonly Tryptic background (long peptides)  lower_better
#> 4           frac_cterm_KR        C-terminal K/R (diagnostic)  lower_better
#> 5      anchor_information               Anchor motif clarity higher_better
#> 6        frac_nested_core          Nested cores (diagnostic) higher_better
#> 7        frac_cross_class          Cross-class contamination  lower_better
#> 8         frac_charge_1_2                       Charge 1+/2+ higher_better
#> 9            n_unique_pep                    Unique peptides higher_better
#> 10 n_unique_pep_in_window          Unique peptides in window higher_better
#> 11      n_source_proteins                    Source proteins higher_better
#> 12         median_abs_ppm                       Median |ppm|  lower_better
#> 13    median_abs_rt_error         Median |RT - predicted RT|  lower_better
#> 14    median_abs_im_error     Median |1/k0 - predicted 1/k0|  lower_better
#>    green amber weight
#> 1   0.80  0.60    3.0
#> 2   0.35  0.20    1.5
#> 3   0.30  0.50    1.0
#> 4   0.30  0.50    0.0
#> 5   2.00  1.00    3.0
#> 6   0.25  0.10    0.0
#> 7   0.05  0.15    0.5
#> 8   0.85  0.70    1.5
#> 9     NA    NA    0.5
#> 10    NA    NA    0.5
#> 11    NA    NA    0.5
#> 12  5.00 10.00    1.0
#> 13  0.50  1.50    0.5
#> 14  0.01  0.03    0.5
quality_thresholds_default("MHC1_mouse")
